In Run and Loop, Hold keeps the envelope at its top for 10 seconds × the stored value²: 0.2 is 0.4 s, 0.4 1.6 s, 0.6 3.6 s. In Env mode it is the sustain level held while the key is down (Microfreak/UG/09 Envelope Gen/06 Cycling Envelope/01 Cycling Envelope Stages).

The low-pass corner, where a sawtooth's harmonics fell 3 dB below their level with the filter open, resonance 0: about 140 Hz at 0.3, 300 Hz at 0.4, 580 Hz at 0.5, 1.24 kHz at 0.6, 2.7 kHz at 0.7 and 6.5 kHz at 0.8. It roughly doubles for every 0.1. Below 0.3 it sat under 110 Hz, and above 0.8 above what the harmonics measured.

Resonance, VCF.Reso, raises a peak just above the cutoff. At cutoff 0.5 the peak stood 0.3 dB above the passband at 0.2, 1.7 dB at 0.4, 2.9 dB at 0.5, 4.3 dB at 0.6, 6.5 dB at 0.7, 9.4 dB at 0.8, 15.3 dB at 0.9 and 26.5 dB at 1.0, where the cutoff frequency became the loudest part of the sound.

With LFO.Sync off, the rate roughly doubles for every 0.1 of stored value from 0.3 up. Measured: 0.1 → 0.14 Hz, 0.2 → 0.24 Hz, 0.3 → 0.52 Hz, 0.4 → 1.07 Hz, 0.5 → 2.25 Hz, 0.6 → 4.79 Hz, 0.7 → 10.3 Hz, 0.75 → 15.0 Hz, 0.8 → 21.9 Hz, 0.85 → 32 Hz, 0.9 → 47 Hz, 0.95 → 69 Hz, 1.0 → 100 Hz. lib/patch_fields.py interpolates between these points.

The tempo is the MIDI clock's: 1/4 ran at 1.5 Hz under clock at 90 BPM and 2.5 Hz at 150 BPM. With no clock running the LFO keeps the last tempo received, and Arp.Rate does not change it.

The matrix (Microfreak/UG/05 Connections/02 Matrix and Encoder/01 Sources and Destinations) stores one amount per crossing as CoN.ROW. The column number is the destination: Co1 Pitch, Co2 Wave, Co3 Timbre, Co4 Cutoff, and Co5–Co7 Assign 1–3. The row is the source: EG1 the Cycling Envelope, EG2 the Envelope, LFO, Xpr Pressure and Key Key/Arp.
How a preset stores its patch settings
An amount is −1 to 1, stored as a signed value over 32767. Co2 did what assigning VCO.Param1 did, and Co3 what assigning VCO.Param2 did.
How a preset stores its patch settings

On Pitch, 1.0 is 48 semitones, four octaves, at the source's full value: 0.25 is an octave, 0.02 about one semitone, and a negative amount bends down. Full channel pressure counts as 127/128. Pressure into Pitch at 1.0 stopped rising near B6.

Each stores the destination id of the parameter its Assign column modulates. The sequencer's modulation tracks use the same ids (Microfreak/Sequence/Storage).
How a preset stores its patch settings

A destination id has four hex digits: the first two name a section and the last two a field in it. Sections: 0x00 oscillator (VCO), 0x01 filter (VCF), 0x02 Cycling Envelope (EG1), 0x03 keyboard (Kbd), 0x04 arpeggiator (Arp), 0x05 LFO, 0x06 Envelope (EG2), 0x07 general (Gen), 0x09 matrix settings (Mat), 0x0A–0x10 the matrix columns Co1–Co7, 0x12 Seq and 0x13 Voc. Freakout's live map lists two or three addresses per field; the destination id is the one in the field's own section, such as 0x0101 for VCF.Cutoff. lib/patch_fields.py builds the full list.
